name: Jeet Prakash
title: Technical Lead Engineer | Distributed Systems & GenAI
bio: Result-oriented Technical Lead Engineer with 12 years of overall IT experience specializing in full-stack enterprise application development. Proven track record of designing, architecting, and scaling high-volume backends using Java 21, Spring Boot, Microservices, Kafka, Redis, and cloud-native architectures. Adept at leading engineering teams, implementing Distributed Systems, AI/RAG chatbot solutions, and orchestrating complex third-party system integrations.

experience.project: Low-Code Digital Lending & Customer Onboarding Platform (2022 – Present)
highlights: Led an engineering team of 5 in developing a flagship low-code digital lending platform automating data extraction, multi-channel verification, and automated underwriting for financial institutions.

Modernized legacy Groovy/Grails architecture by decomposing it into a centralized orchestration layer and independently deployable microservices using modern Java and Spring Cloud, accelerating feature delivery and system scalability.
Designed and deployed a RAG-based AI chatbot using LLMs (Claude) to resolve loan applicants' queries regarding retail banking products.
Spearheaded design and execution of a Custom Message Service for REST API error-handling, reducing debugging time and standardizing error responses across consumer integrations.
Engineered an automated Loan Archival engine capable of executing data archiving based on dynamic, user-defined configurations, significantly reducing node memory requirements.
Led low-level technical design (LLD) and PR code reviews, maintaining strict clean code principles, architectural alignment, and comprehensive test coverage within an Agile/Scrum framework.
Managed a team of 7 developers building pluggable Enterprise Connectors to extend integration capabilities across E-Commerce, CRM/ERP, ITSM, and Data Warehouse domains.
Gathered business requirements and translated complex use cases into scalable low-level technical design (LLD) specifications.
Utilized the Java Executor Framework to optimize multithreaded performance for high-throughput data synchronization pipelines.
Headed sprint planning, owned user story assignments, and drove daily standups to communicate clear progress metrics to stakeholders.
Established CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions and Jenkins to automate connector verification and delivery.
Developed core RESTful services and business logic layer for an enterprise iPaaS product facilitating seamless data transformation across XML, JDBC, and Flat Files.
Successfully managed legacy UI migration, porting front-end modules from JSP to Angular 8.
Designed and implemented a real-time logging infrastructure powered by Apache Kafka and InfluxDB for live integration tracking.
Built back-end RESTful web services serving structured JSON data for mobile clients.
Implemented geo-fencing business logic to support anonymous location-based networking hotspots (TAN) within defined radii.
